title: Choose ShellFlow's look · bolder hand
question: A bolder hand, as you asked. The layout you know stays the same in every option; only the look changes. Keep the lead, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Weight Specimen
options.lineage: Type foundry specimens: one face at enormous size, every weight on one sheet
options.thesis: Progress is set in type weight: a step's numeral thickens from hairline to black as its gate fills.
options.viewport: The same header and two-row menu; step numerals drawn at the weight of their progress, the page title and contract value at specimen scale.
options.risk: Weight alone is subtle, so every numeral also carries its percentage for anyone who cannot judge weight at a glance.

raised.raise: Capacity is a hard line: plant load and each lorry fill to their limit, and nothing may run past it unnoticed.
The ultramarine appears only on things you can press or that are selected.
On phones, site receiving shows one delivery at a time, the next one swipe away.
Flat colour throughout: no gradients, glass or grain anywhere.

options.label: Construction Grid
options.lineage: Gridded modernist type specimens built cell by cell
options.thesis: Everything sits on a visible module grid, and panels fill their cells on the grid as they are cast.
options.viewport: The same header and menu over a faint module grid; the active step is the one red-orange plane, and the panel register fills cell by cell beside the form.
options.case: Beats the lead on both counts: a panel maker's teams think in modules and shop-drawing grids, and filled cells are counted, not judged.
options.risk: Too many visible grid lines turn into noise; they must stay hairline-faint behind the work.

options.label: Mixtape Card
options.thesis: Ballpoint lists timed to fill a tape side exactly.
options.case: Staff know cassettes, but handwriting cannot meet the luxury brief and slows reading figures.
options.kept: Capacity as a hard line nothing may overflow.

options.label: Friendly App
options.thesis: Soft cards and one bright colour for actions.
options.viewport: Stacked soft cards with a bottom bar.
options.case: Familiar from phone apps, but it reads as a shopping app, not a luxury operations system.
options.risk: Loses density and the luxury brief.
options.kept: The accent appears only on things you can press.

options.label: Full-Screen Feed
options.thesis: One item fills the screen; the next is one flick away.
options.case: Loses both: operations work compares many records at once.
options.risk: Hides the tables people work from.
options.kept: On phones, one delivery at a time with the next one swipe away.

options.label: Garden Guide Map
options.thesis: Areas as swelling lobes of flat colour.
options.case: Loses both: playful shapes replace the layout staff learned.
options.kept: Flat colour, with no gradients or grain.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What top operations software ships, executed impeccably: white, slate greys, one blue accent.
canonCard.viewport: The same header, menu and form, in the familiar enterprise look at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other systems by design; the luxury lives only in finish.
